rule Suspicious_Dll_Load_Temp
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects unsigned DLL loaded from user Temp directory via rundll32"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE T1218.011"
        date = "2026-04-12"
    strings:
        $temp_path = /\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]+\.dll/i
        $rundll32 = "rundll32.exe" nocase
    condition:
        $temp_path and $rundll32
}
